text_la: Dixitque Saul ad Samuelem : Peccavi, quia prævaricatus sum sermonem Domini et verba tua, timens populum, et obediens voci eorum.
text_pt: Então disse Saul a Samuel: Pequei, porquanto tenho transgredido a ordem do Senhor e as tuas palavras; porque temi ao povo, e dei ouvidos à sua voz.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Σαουλ πρὸς Σαμουηλ ἡμάρτηκα ὅτι παρέβην τὸν λόγον κυρίου καὶ τὸ ῥῆμά σου ὅτι ἐφοβήθην τὸν λαὸν καὶ ἤκουσα τῆς φωνῆς αὐτῶν

text_en: But now bear, I beseech you, my sin , and return with me, that I may adore the Lord .
text_la: Sed nunc porta, quæso, peccatum meum, et revertere mecum, ut adorem Dominum.
text_pt: Agora, pois, rogo-te perdoa o meu pecado; e volta comigo, para que adore ao Senhor.
text_el: καὶ νῦν ἆρον δὴ τὸ ἁμάρτημά μου καὶ ἀνάστρεψον μετ' ἐμοῦ καὶ προσκυνήσω κυρίῳ τῷ θεῷ σου

text_en: And Samuel said to Saul : I will not return with you, because you have rejected the word of the Lord , and the Lord has rejected you from being king over Israel .
text_la: Et ait Samuel ad Saul : Non revertar tecum, quia projecisti sermonem Domini, et projecit te Dominus ne sis rex super Israël.
text_pt: Porém Samuel disse a Saul: Não voltarei contigo; porquanto rejeitaste a palavra do Senhor, já te rejeitou o Senhor, para que não sejas rei sobre Israel.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Σαμουηλ πρὸς Σαουλ οὐκ ἀναστρέφω μετὰ σοῦ ὅτι ἐξουδένωσας τὸ ῥῆμα κυρίου καὶ ἐξουδενώσει σε κύριος τοῦ μὴ εἶναι βασιλέα ἐπὶ τὸν Ισραηλ

text_en: And Samuel turned about to go away: but he laid hold upon the skirt of his mantle, and it rent.
text_la: Et conversus est Samuel ut abiret : ille autem apprehendit summitatem pallii ejus, quæ et scissa est.
text_pt: E virando-se Samuel para se ir, ele lhe pegou pela orla da capa, e a rasgou.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστρεψεν Σαμουηλ τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ τοῦ ἀπελθεῖν καὶ ἐκράτησεν Σαουλ τοῦ πτερυγίου τῆς διπλοΐδος αὐτοῦ καὶ διέρρηξεν αὐτό

text_en: And Samuel said to him: The Lord has rent the kingdom of Israel from you this day, and has given it to your neighbour who is better than you.
text_la: Et ait ad eum Samuel : Scidit Dominus regnum Israël a te hodie, et tradidit illud proximo tuo meliori te.
text_pt: Então Samuel lhe disse: O Senhor tem rasgado de ti hoje o reino de Israel, e o tem dado ao teu próximo, melhor do que tu.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτὸν Σαμουηλ διέρρηξεν κύριος τὴν βασιλείαν Ισραηλ ἐκ χειρός σου σήμερον καὶ δώσει αὐτὴν τῷ πλησίον σου τῷ ἀγαθῷ ὑπὲρ σέ

text_en: But the triumpher in Israel will not spare, and will not be moved to repentance : for he is not a man that he should repent .
text_la: Porro triumphator in Israël non parcet, et pœnitudine non flectetur : neque enim homo est ut agat pœnitentiam.
text_pt: E também aquele que é a Força de Israel não mente nem se arrepende; porquanto não é um homem para que se arrependa.
text_el: καὶ διαιρεθήσεται Ισραηλ εἰς δύο καὶ οὐκ ἀποστρέψει οὐδὲ μετανοήσει ὅτι οὐχ ὡς ἄνθρωπός ἐστιν τοῦ μετανοῆσαι αὐτός

text_en: Then he said: I have sinned : yet honour me now before the ancients of my people, and before Israel , and return with me, that I may adore the Lord your God .
text_la: At ille ait : Peccavi : sed nunc honora me coram senioribus populi mei et coram Israël, et revertere mecum, ut adorem Dominum Deum tuum.
text_pt: Disse ele então: Pequei; honra-me, porém, agora diante dos anciãos do meu povo, e diante de Israel; e volta comigo, para que adore ao Senhor teu Deus.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Σαουλ ἡμάρτηκα ἀλλὰ δόξασόν με δὴ ἐνώπιον πρεσβυτέρων Ισραηλ καὶ ἐνώπιον λαοῦ μου καὶ ἀνάστρεψον μετ' ἐμοῦ καὶ προσκυνήσω τῷ κυρίῳ θεῷ σου

text_en: So Samuel turned again after Saul : and Saul adored the Lord .
text_la: Reversus ergo Samuel secutus est Saulem : et adoravit Saul Dominum.
text_pt: Então, voltando Samuel, seguiu a Saul; e Saul adorou ao Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέστρεψεν Σαμουηλ ὀπίσω Σαουλ καὶ προσεκύνησεν τῷ κυρίῳ

text_en: And Samuel said: Bring hither to me Agag, the king of Amalec . And Agag was presented to him very fat, and trembling. And Agag said: Does bitter death separate in this manner?
text_la: Dixitque Samuel : Adducite ad me Agag regem Amalec. Et oblatus est ei Agag, pinguissimus et tremens. Et dixit Agag : Siccine separat amara mors?
text_pt: Então disse Samuel: Trazei-me aqui a Agague, rei dos amalequitas. E Agague veio a ele animosamente; e disse Agague: Na verdade já passou a amargura da morte.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Σαμουηλ προσαγάγετέ μοι τὸν Αγαγ βασιλέα Αμαληκ καὶ προσῆλθεν πρὸς αὐτὸν Αγαγ τρέμων καὶ εἶπεν Αγαγ εἰ οὕτως πικρὸς ὁ θάνατος

text_en: And Samuel said: As your sword has made women childless, so shall your mother be childless among women . And Samuel hewed him in pieces before the Lord in Galgal.
text_la: Et ait Samuel : Sicut fecit absque liberis mulieres gladius tuus, sic absque liberis erit inter mulieres mater tua. Et in frustra concidit eum Samuel coram Domino in Galgalis.
text_pt: Disse, porém, Samuel: Assim como a tua espada desfilhou as mulheres, assim ficará desfilhada a tua mãe entre as mulheres. Então Samuel despedaçou a Agague perante o Senhor em Gilgal.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Σαμουηλ πρὸς Αγαγ καθότι ἠτέκνωσεν γυναῖκας ἡ ῥομφαία σου οὕτως ἀτεκνωθήσεται ἐκ γυναικῶν ἡ μήτηρ σου καὶ ἔσφαξεν Σαμουηλ τὸν Αγαγ ἐνώπιον κυρίου ἐν Γαλγαλ

text_en: And Samuel departed to Ramatha: but Saul went up to his house in Gabaa.
text_la: Abiit autem Samuel in Ramatha : Saul vero ascendit in domum suam in Gabaa.
text_pt: Então Samuel se foi a Ramá; e Saul subiu à sua casa, a Gibeá de Saul.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆλθεν Σαμουηλ εἰς Αρμαθαιμ καὶ Σαουλ ἀνέβη εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ εἰς Γαβαα

text_en: And Samuel saw Saul no more till the day of his death: nevertheless, Samuel mourned for Saul , because the Lord repented that he had made him king over Israel .
text_la: Et non vidit Samuel ultra Saul usque ad diem mortis suæ : verumtamen lugebat Samuel Saulem, quoniam Dominum pœnitebat quod constituisset eum regem super Israël.
text_pt: E nunca mais viu Samuel a Saul até ao dia da sua morte; porque Samuel teve dó de Saul. E o Senhor se arrependeu de haver posto a Saul rei sobre Israel.
text_el: καὶ οὐ προσέθετο Σαμουηλ ἔτι ἰδεῖν τὸν Σαουλ ἕως ἡμέρας θανάτου αὐτοῦ ὅτι ἐπένθει Σαμουηλ ἐπὶ Σαουλ καὶ κύριος μετεμελήθη ὅτι ἐβασίλευσεν τὸν Σαουλ ἐπὶ Ισραηλ

text_en: And the Lord said to Samuel: How long will you mourn for Saul , whom I have rejected from reigning over Israel ? Fill your horn with oil, and come, that I may send you to Isai, the Bethlehemite : for I have provided me a king among his sons.
text_la: Dixitque Dominus ad Samuelem : Usquequo tu luges Saul, cum ego projecerim eum ne regnet super Israël? Imple cornu tuum oleo, et veni, ut mittam te ad Isai Bethlehemitem : providi enim in filiis ejus mihi regem.
text_pt: Então disse o SENHOR a Samuel: Até quando terás dó de Saul, havendo-o eu rejeitado, para que não reine sobre Israel? Enche um chifre de azeite, e vem, enviar-te-ei a Jessé o belemita; porque dentre os seus filhos me tenho provido de um rei.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Σαμουηλ ἕως πότε σὺ πενθεῖς ἐπὶ Σαουλ κἀγὼ ἐξουδένωκα αὐτὸν μὴ βασιλεύειν ἐπὶ Ισραηλ πλῆσον τὸ κέρας σου ἐλαίου καὶ δεῦρο ἀποστείλω σε πρὸς Ιεσσαι ἕως εἰς Βηθλεεμ ὅτι ἑόρακα ἐν τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτοῦ ἐμοὶ βασιλεύειν

text_en: And Samuel said: How shall I go? For Saul will hear of it, and he will kill me. And the Lord said: You shall take with you a calf of the herd, and you shall say: I have come to sacrifice to the Lord .
text_la: Et ait Samuel : Quomodo vadam? audiet enim Saul, et interficiet me. Et ait Dominus : Vitulum de armento tolles in manu tua, et dices : Ad immolandum Domino veni.
text_pt: Porém disse Samuel: Como irei eu? pois, ouvindo-o Saul, me matará. Então disse o Senhor: Toma uma bezerra das vacas em tuas mãos, e dize: Vim para sacrificar ao Senhor.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Σαμουηλ πῶς πορευθῶ καὶ ἀκούσεται Σαουλ καὶ ἀποκτενεῖ με καὶ εἶπεν κύριος δάμαλιν βοῶν λαβὲ ἐν τῇ χειρί σου καὶ ἐρεῖς θῦσαι τῷ κυρίῳ ἥκω

text_en: And you shall call Isai to the sacrifice , and I will show you what you are to do, and you shall anoint him whom I shall show to you.
text_la: Et vocabis Isai ad victimam, et ego ostendam tibi quid facias, et unges quemcumque monstravero tibi.
text_pt: E convidarás a Jessé ao sacrifício; e eu te farei saber o que hás de fazer, e ungir-me-ás a quem eu te disser.
text_el: καὶ καλέσεις τὸν Ιεσσαι εἰς τὴν θυσίαν καὶ γνωριῶ σοι ἃ ποιήσεις καὶ χρίσεις ὃν ἐὰν εἴπω πρὸς σέ

text_en: Then Samuel did as the Lord had said to him. And he came to Bethlehem , and the ancients of the city wondered, and meeting him, they said: Is your coming hither peaceable?
text_la: Fecit ergo Samuel sicut locutus est ei Dominus. Venitque in Bethlehem, et admirati sunt seniores civitatis occurrentes ei : dixeruntque : Pacificusne est ingressus tuus?
text_pt: Fez, pois, Samuel o que dissera o Senhor, e veio a Belém; então os anciãos da cidade saíram ao encontro, tremendo, e disseram: De paz é a tua vinda?
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν Σαμουηλ πάντα ἃ ἐλάλησεν αὐτῷ κύριος καὶ ἦλθεν εἰς Βηθλεεμ καὶ ἐξέστησαν οἱ πρεσβύτεροι τῆς πόλεως τῇ ἀπαντήσει αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπαν εἰρήνη ἡ εἴσοδός σου ὁ βλέπων

text_en: And he said: It is peaceable: I have come to offer sacrifice to the Lord , be sanctified , and come with me to the sacrifice . And he sanctified Isai and his sons, and called them to the sacrifice .
text_la: Et ait : Pacificus : ad immolandum Domino veni : sanctificamini, et venite mecum ut immolem. Sanctificavit ergo Isai et filios ejus, et vocavit eos ad sacrificium.
text_pt: E disse ele: É de paz, vim sacrificar ao Senhor; santificai-vos, e vinde comigo ao sacrifício. E santificou ele a Jessé e a seus filhos, e os convidou ao sacrifício.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν εἰρήνη θῦσαι τῷ κυρίῳ ἥκω ἁγιάσθητε καὶ εὐφράνθητε μετ' ἐμοῦ σήμερον καὶ ἡγίασεν τὸν Ιεσσαι καὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐκάλεσεν αὐτοὺς εἰς τὴν θυσίαν

text_en: And when they had come in, he saw Eliab, and said: Is the Lord's anointed before him?
text_la: Cumque ingressi essent, vidit Eliab, et ait : Num coram Domino est christus ejus?
text_pt: E sucedeu que, entrando eles, viu a Eliabe, e disse: Certamente está perante o Senhor o seu ungido.
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθη ἐν τῷ αὐτοὺς εἰσιέναι καὶ εἶδεν τὸν Ελιαβ καὶ εἶπεν ἀλλὰ καὶ ἐνώπιον κυρίου χριστὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: And the Lord said to Samuel: Look not on his countenance, nor on the height of his stature: because I have rejected him, nor do I judge according to the look of man : for man sees those things that appear, but the Lord beholds the heart.
text_la: Et dixit Dominus ad Samuelem : Ne respicias vultum ejus, neque altitudinem staturæ ejus : quoniam abjeci eum, nec juxta intuitum hominis ego judico : homo enim videt ea quæ parent, Dominus autem intuetur cor.
text_pt: Porém o Senhor disse a Samuel: Não atentes para a sua aparência, nem para a grandeza da sua estatura, porque o tenho rejeitado; porque o Senhor não vê como vê o homem, pois o homem vê o que está diante dos olhos, porém o Senhor olha para o coração.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Σαμουηλ μὴ ἐπιβλέψῃς ἐπὶ τὴν ὄψιν αὐτοῦ μηδὲ εἰς τὴν ἕξιν μεγέθους αὐτοῦ ὅτι ἐξουδένωκα αὐτόν ὅτι οὐχ ὡς ἐμβλέψεται ἄνθρωπος ὄψεται ὁ θεός ὅτι ἄνθρωπος ὄψεται εἰς πρόσωπον ὁ δὲ θεὸς ὄψεται εἰς καρδίαν

text_en: And Isai called Abinadab, and brought him before Samuel. And he said: Neither has the Lord chosen this,
text_la: Et vocavit Isai Abinadab, et adduxit eum coram Samuele. Qui dixit : Nec hunc elegit Dominus.
text_pt: Então chamou Jessé a Abinadabe, e o fez passar diante de Samuel, o qual disse: Nem a este tem escolhido o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν Ιεσσαι τὸν Αμιναδαβ καὶ παρῆλθεν κατὰ πρόσωπον Σαμουηλ καὶ εἶπεν οὐδὲ τοῦτον ἐξελέξατο κύριος

text_en: and Isai brought Samma, and he said of him: Neither has the Lord chosen this.
text_la: Adduxit autem Isai Samma, de quo ait : Etiam hunc non elegit Dominus.
text_pt: Então Jessé fez passar a Sama; porém disse: Tampouco a este tem escolhido o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ παρήγαγεν Ιεσσαι τὸν Σαμα καὶ εἶπεν καὶ ἐν τούτῳ οὐκ ἐξελέξατο κύριος

text_en: Isai therefore brought his seven sons before Samuel: and Samuel said to Isai: The Lord has not chosen any one of these.
text_la: Adduxit itaque Isai septem filios suos coram Samuele : et ait Samuel ad Isai : Non elegit Dominus ex istis.
text_pt: Assim fez passar Jessé a seus sete filhos diante de Samuel; porém Samuel disse a Jessé: O Senhor não tem escolhido a estes.
text_el: καὶ παρήγαγεν Ιεσσαι τοὺς ἑπτὰ υἱοὺς αὐτοῦ ἐνώπιον Σαμουηλ καὶ εἶπεν Σαμουηλ οὐκ ἐξελέξατο κύριος ἐν τούτοις

text_en: And Samuel said to Isai: Are here all your sons? He answered: There remains yet a young one, who keeps the sheep. And Samuel said to Isai: Send, and fetch him: for we will not sit down till he come hither.
text_la: Dixitque Samuel ad Isai : Numquid jam completi sunt filii? Qui respondit : Adhuc reliquus est parvulus, et pascit oves. Et ait Samuel ad Isai : Mitte, et adduc eum : nec enim discumbemus priusquam huc ille veniat.
text_pt: Disse mais Samuel a Jessé: Acabaram-se os moços? E disse: Ainda falta o menor, que está apascentando as ovelhas. Disse, pois, Samuel a Jessé: Manda chamá-lo, porquanto não nos assentaremos até que ele venha aqui.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Σαμουηλ πρὸς Ιεσσαι ἐκλελοίπασιν τὰ παιδάρια καὶ εἶπεν ἔτι ὁ μικρὸς ἰδοὺ ποιμαίνει ἐν τῷ ποιμνίῳ καὶ εἶπεν Σαμουηλ πρὸς Ιεσσαι ἀπόστειλον καὶ λαβὲ αὐτόν ὅτι οὐ μὴ κατακλιθῶμεν ἕως τοῦ ἐλθεῖν αὐτόν

text_en: He sent therefore and brought him. Now he was ruddy and beautiful to behold, and of a comely face. And the Lord said: Arise, and anoint him, for this is he.
text_la: Misit ergo, et adduxit eum. Erat autem rufus, et pulcher aspectu, decoraque facie : et ait Dominus : Surge, unge eum : ipse est enim.
text_pt: Então mandou chamá-lo e fê-lo entrar (e era ruivo e formoso de semblante e de boa presença); e disse o Senhor: Levanta-te, e unge-o, porque é este mesmo.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν καὶ εἰσήγαγεν αὐτόν καὶ οὗτος πυρράκης μετὰ κάλλους ὀφθαλμῶν καὶ ἀγαθὸς ὁράσει κυρίῳ καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Σαμουηλ ἀνάστα καὶ χρῖσον τὸν Δαυιδ ὅτι οὗτος ἀγαθός ἐστιν

text_en: Then Samuel took the horn of oil, and anointed him in the midst of his brethren: and the Spirit of the Lord came upon David from that day forward: and Samuel rose up, and went to Ramatha.
text_la: Tulit ergo Samuel cornu olei, et unxit eum in medio fratrum ejus : et directus est spiritus Domini a die illa in David, et deinceps. Surgensque Samuel abiit in Ramatha.
text_pt: Então Samuel tomou o chifre do azeite, e ungiu-o no meio de seus irmãos; e desde aquele dia em diante o Espírito do Senhor se apoderou de Davi; então Samuel se levantou, e voltou a Ramá.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν Σαμουηλ τὸ κέρας τοῦ ἐλαίου καὶ ἔχρισεν αὐτὸν ἐν μέσῳ τῶν ἀδελφῶν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐφήλατο πνεῦμα κυρίου ἐπὶ Δαυιδ ἀπὸ τῆς ἡμέρας ἐκείνης καὶ ἐπάνω καὶ ἀνέστη Σαμουηλ καὶ ἀπῆλθεν εἰς Αρμαθαιμ

text_en: But the Spirit of the Lord departed from Saul , and an evil spirit from the Lord troubled him.
text_la: Spiritus autem Domini recessit a Saul, et exagitabat eum spiritus nequam a Domino.
text_pt: E o Espírito do Senhor se retirou de Saul, e atormentava-o um espírito mau da parte do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ πνεῦμα κυρίου ἀπέστη ἀπὸ Σαουλ καὶ ἔπνιγεν αὐτὸν πνεῦμα πονηρὸν παρὰ κυρίου

text_en: And the servants of Saul said to him: Behold now an evil spirit from God troubles you.
text_la: Dixeruntque servi Saul ad eum : Ecce spiritus Dei malus exagitat te.
text_pt: Então os criados de Saul lhe disseram: Eis que agora o espírito mau da parte de Deus te atormenta;
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν οἱ παῖδες Σαουλ πρὸς αὐτόν ἰδοὺ δὴ πνεῦμα κυρίου πονηρὸν πνίγει σε

text_en: Let our lord give orders, and your servants who are before you, will seek out a man skilful in playing on the harp, that when the evil spirit from the Lord is upon you, he may play with his hand, and you may bear it more easily.
text_la: Jubeat dominus noster, et servi tui qui coram te sunt quærent hominem scientem psallere cithara, ut quando arripuerit te spiritus Domini malus, psallat manu sua, et levius feras.
text_pt: Diga, pois, nosso senhor a seus servos, que estão na tua presença, que busquem um homem que saiba tocar harpa, e será que, quando o espírito mau da parte de Deus vier sobre ti, então ele tocará com a sua mão, e te acharás melhor.
text_el: εἰπάτωσαν δὴ οἱ δοῦλοί σου ἐνώπιόν σου καὶ ζητησάτωσαν τῷ κυρίῳ ἡμῶν ἄνδρα εἰδότα ψάλλειν ἐν κινύρᾳ καὶ ἔσται ἐν τῷ εἶναι πνεῦμα πονηρὸν ἐπὶ σοὶ καὶ ψαλεῖ ἐν τῇ κινύρᾳ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀγαθόν σοι ἔσται καὶ ἀναπαύσει σε

text_en: And Saul said to his servants: Provide me then some man that can play well, and bring him to me.
text_la: Et ait Saul ad servos suos : Providete ergo mihi aliquem bene psallentem, et adducite eum ad me.
text_pt: Então disse Saul aos seus servos: Buscai-me, pois, um homem que toque bem, e trazei-mo.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Σαουλ πρὸς τοὺς παῖδας αὐτοῦ ἴδετε δή μοι ἄνδρα ὀρθῶς ψάλλοντα καὶ εἰσαγάγετε αὐτὸν πρὸς ἐμέ

text_en: And one of the servants answering, said: Behold I have seen a son of Isai, the Bethlehemite , a skilful player, and one of great strength, and a man fit for war , and prudent in his words, and a comely person: and the Lord is with him.
text_la: Et respondens unus de pueris, ait : Ecce vidi filium Isai Bethlehemitem scientem psallere, et fortissimum robore, et virum bellicosum, et prudentem in verbis, et virum pulchrum : et Dominus est cum eo.
text_pt: Então respondeu um dos moços, e disse: Eis que tenho visto a um filho de Jessé, o belemita, que sabe tocar e é valente e vigoroso, e homem de guerra, e prudente em palavras, e de gentil presença; o Senhor é com ele.
text_el: καὶ ἀπεκρίθη εἷς τῶν παιδαρίων αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπεν ἰδοὺ ἑόρακα υἱὸν τῷ Ιεσσαι Βηθλεεμίτην καὶ αὐτὸν εἰδότα ψαλμόν καὶ ὁ ἀνὴρ συνετός καὶ ὁ ἀνὴρ πολεμιστὴς καὶ σοφὸς λόγῳ καὶ ἀνὴρ ἀγαθὸς τῷ εἴδει καὶ κύριος μετ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: Then Saul sent messengers to Isai, saying: Send me David , your son, who is in the pastures.
text_la: Misit ergo Saul nuntios ad Isai, dicens : Mitte ad me David filium tuum, qui est in pascuis.
text_pt: E Saul enviou mensageiros a Jessé, dizendo: Envia-me Davi, teu filho, o que está com as ovelhas.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Σαουλ ἀγγέλους πρὸς Ιεσσαι λέγων ἀπόστειλον πρός με τὸν υἱόν σου Δαυιδ τὸν ἐν τῷ ποιμνίῳ σου

text_en: And Isai took an ass laden with bread, and a bottle of wine, and a kid of the flock, and sent them by the hand of David , his son, to Saul .
text_la: Tulit itaque Isai asinum plenum panibus, et lagenam vini, et hædum de capris unum, et misit per manum David filii sui Sauli.
text_pt: Então tomou Jessé um jumento carregado de pão, e um odre de vinho, e um cabrito, e enviou-os a Saul pela mão de Davi, seu filho.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν Ιεσσαι γομορ ἄρτων καὶ ἀσκὸν οἴνου καὶ ἔριφον αἰγῶν ἕνα καὶ ἐξαπέστειλεν ἐν χειρὶ Δαυιδ τοῦ υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ πρὸς Σαουλ

text_en: And David came to Saul , and stood before him: and he loved him exceedingly, and made him his armourbearer.
text_la: Et venit David ad Saul, et stetit coram eo : at ille dilexit eum nimis, et factus est ejus armiger.
text_pt: Assim Davi veio a Saul, e esteve perante ele, e o amou muito, e foi seu pajem de armas.
text_el: καὶ εἰσῆλθεν Δαυιδ πρὸς Σαουλ καὶ παρειστήκει ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἠγάπησεν αὐτὸν σφόδρα καὶ ἐγενήθη αὐτῷ αἴρων τὰ σκεύη αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Saul sent to Isai, saying: Let David stand before me: for he has found favour in my sight.
text_la: Misitque Saul ad Isai, dicens : Stet David in conspectu meo : invenit enim gratiam in oculis meis.
text_pt: Então Saul mandou dizer a Jessé: Deixa estar a Davi perante mim, pois achou graça em meus olhos.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Σαουλ πρὸς Ιεσσαι λέγων παριστάσθω δὴ Δαυιδ ἐνώπιον ἐμοῦ ὅτι εὗρεν χάριν ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς μου

text_en: So whensoever the evil spirit from the Lord was upon Saul , David took his harp, and played with his hand, and Saul was refreshed, and was better, for the evil spirit departed from him.
text_la: Igitur quandocumque spiritus Domini malus arripiebat Saul, David tollebat citharam, et percutiebat manu sua, et refocillabatur Saul, et levius habebat : recedebat enim ab eo spiritus malus.
text_pt: E sucedia que, quando o espírito mau da parte de Deus vinha sobre Saul, Davi tomava a harpa, e a tocava com a sua mão; então Saul sentia alívio, e se achava melhor, e o espírito mau se retirava dele.
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθη ἐν τῷ εἶναι πνεῦμα πονηρὸν ἐπὶ Σαουλ καὶ ἐλάμβανεν Δαυιδ τὴν κινύραν καὶ ἔψαλλεν ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀνέψυχεν Σαουλ καὶ ἀγαθὸν αὐτῷ καὶ ἀφίστατο ἀπ' αὐτοῦ τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ πονηρόν

text_en: Now the Philistines gathering together their troops to battle, assembled at Socho of Juda : and camped between Socho and Azeca, in the borders of Dommim.
text_la: Congregantes autem Philisthiim agmina sua in prælium, convenerunt in Socho Judæ : et castrametati sunt inter Socho et Azeca in finibus Dommim.
text_pt: E os filisteus ajuntaram as suas forças para a guerra e congregaram-se em Socó, que está em Judá, e acamparam-se entre Socó e Azeca, no termo de Damim.
text_el: καὶ συνάγουσιν ἀλλόφυλοι τὰς παρεμβολὰς αὐτῶν εἰς πόλεμον καὶ συνάγονται εἰς Σοκχωθ τῆς Ιουδαίας καὶ παρεμβάλλουσιν ἀνὰ μέσον Σοκχωθ καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον Αζηκα ἐν Εφερμεμ

text_en: And Saul and the children of Israel being gathered together, came to the valley of Terebinth, and they set the army in array to fight against the Philistines .
text_la: Porro Saul et filii Israël congregati venerunt in Vallem terebinthi, et direxerunt aciem ad pugnandum contra Philisthiim.
text_pt: Porém Saul e os homens de Israel se ajuntaram e acamparam no vale do carvalho, e ordenaram a batalha contra os filisteus.
text_el: καὶ Σαουλ καὶ οἱ ἄνδρες Ισραηλ συνάγονται καὶ παρεμβάλλουσιν ἐν τῇ κοιλάδι αὐτοὶ παρατάσσονται εἰς πόλεμον ἐξ ἐναντίας ἀλλοφύλων

text_en: And the Philistines stood on a mountain on the one side, and Israel stood on a mountain on the other side: and there was a valley between them.
text_la: Et Philisthiim stabant super montem ex parte hac, et Israël stabat supra montem ex altera parte : vallisque erat inter eos.
text_pt: E os filisteus estavam num monte de um lado, e os israelitas estavam num monte do outro lado; e o vale estava entre eles.
text_el: καὶ ἀλλόφυλοι ἵστανται ἐπὶ τοῦ ὄρους ἐνταῦθα καὶ Ισραηλ ἵσταται ἐπὶ τοῦ ὄρους ἐνταῦθα καὶ ὁ αὐλὼν ἀνὰ μέσον αὐτῶν

text_en: And there went out a man baseborn from the camp of the Philistines , named Goliath, of Geth, whose height was six cubits and a span:
text_la: Et egressus est vir spurius de castris Philisthinorum nomine Goliath, de Geth, altitudinis sex cubitorum et palmi:
text_pt: Então saiu do arraial dos filisteus um homem guerreiro, cujo nome era Golias, de Gate, que tinha de altura seis côvados e um palmo.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἀνὴρ δυνατὸς ἐκ τῆς παρατάξεως τῶν ἀλλοφύλων Γολιαθ ὄνομα αὐτῷ ἐκ Γεθ ὕψος αὐτοῦ τεσσάρων πήχεων καὶ σπιθαμῆς

text_en: And he had a helmet of brass upon his head, and he was clothed with a coat of mail with scales, and the weight of his coat of mail was five thousand sicles of brass:
text_la: et cassis ærea super caput ejus, et lorica squamata induebatur. Porro pondus loricæ ejus, quinque millia siclorum æris erat:
text_pt: Trazia na cabeça um capacete de bronze, e vestia uma couraça de escamas; e era o peso da couraça de cinco mil siclos de bronze.
text_el: καὶ περικεφαλαία ἐπὶ τῆς κεφαλῆς αὐτοῦ καὶ θώρακα ἁλυσιδωτὸν αὐτὸς ἐνδεδυκώς καὶ ὁ σταθμὸς τοῦ θώρακος αὐτοῦ πέντε χιλιάδες σίκλων χαλκοῦ καὶ σιδήρου

text_en: And he had greaves of brass on his legs, and a buckler of brass covered his shoulders.
text_la: et ocreas æreas habebat in cruribus, et clypeus æreus tegebat humeros ejus.
text_pt: E trazia grevas de bronze por cima de seus pés, e um escudo de bronze entre os seus ombros.
text_el: καὶ κνημῖδες χαλκαῖ ἐπάνω τῶν σκελῶν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀσπὶς χαλκῆ ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν ὤμων αὐτοῦ

text_en: And the staff of his spear was like a weaver's beam, and the head of his spear weighed six hundred sicles of iron: and his armourbearer went before him.
text_la: Hastile autem hastæ ejus erat quasi liciatorium texentium : ipsum autem ferrum hastæ ejus sexcentos siclos habebat ferri : et armiger ejus antecedebat eum.
text_pt: E a haste da sua lança era como o eixo do tecelão, e a ponta da sua lança de seiscentos siclos de ferro, e diante dele ia o escudeiro.
text_el: καὶ ὁ κοντὸς τοῦ δόρατος αὐτοῦ ὡσεὶ μέσακλον ὑφαινόντων καὶ ἡ λόγχη αὐτοῦ ἑξακοσίων σίκλων σιδήρου καὶ ὁ αἴρων τὰ ὅπλα αὐτοῦ προεπορεύετο αὐτοῦ

text_en: And standing, he cried out to the bands of Israel , and said to them: Why are you come out prepared to fight? Am not I a Philistine , and you the servants of Saul ? Choose out a man of you, and let him come down and fight hand to hand.
text_la: Stansque clamabat adversum phalangas Israël, et dicebat eis : Quare venistis parati ad prælium? numquid ego non sum Philisthæus, et vos servi Saul? eligite ex vobis virum, et descendat ad singulare certamen.
text_pt: E parou, e clamou às companhias de Israel, e disse-lhes: Para que saireis a ordenar a batalha? Não sou eu filisteu e vós servos de Saul? Escolhei dentre vós um homem que desça a mim.
text_el: καὶ ἔστη καὶ ἀνεβόησεν εἰς τὴν παράταξιν Ισραηλ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς τί ἐκπορεύεσθε παρατάξασθαι πολέμῳ ἐξ ἐναντίας ἡμῶν οὐκ ἐγώ εἰμι ἀλλόφυλος καὶ ὑμεῖς Εβραῖοι τοῦ Σαουλ ἐκλέξασθε ἑαυτοῖς ἄνδρα καὶ καταβήτω πρός με

text_en: If he be able to fight with me, and kill me, we will be servants to you: but if I prevail against him, and kill him, you shall be servants, and shall serve us.
text_la: Si quiverit pugnare mecum, et percusserit me, erimus vobis servi : si autem ego prævaluero, et percussero eum, vos servi eritis, et servietis nobis.
text_pt: Se ele puder pelejar comigo, e me ferir, a vós seremos por servos; porém, se eu o vencer, e o ferir, então a nós sereis por servos, e nos servireis.
text_el: καὶ ἐὰν δυνηθῇ πρὸς ἐμὲ πολεμῆσαι καὶ ἐὰν πατάξῃ με καὶ ἐσόμεθα ὑμῖν εἰς δούλους ἐὰν δὲ ἐγὼ δυνηθῶ καὶ πατάξω αὐτόν ἔσεσθε ἡμῖν εἰς δούλους καὶ δουλεύσετε ἡμῖν

text_en: And the Philistine said: I have defied the bands of Israel this day: give me a man , and let him fight with me hand to hand.
text_la: Et aiebat Philisthæus : Ego exprobravi agminibus Israël hodie : date mihi virum, et ineat mecum singulare certamen.
text_pt: Disse mais o filisteu: Hoje desafio as companhias de Israel, dizendo: Dai-me um homem, para que ambos pelejemos.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ ἀλλόφυλος ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ὠνείδισα τὴν παράταξιν Ισραηλ σήμερον ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ταύτῃ δότε μοι ἄνδρα καὶ μονομαχήσομεν ἀμφότεροι

text_en: And Saul and all the Israelites hearing these words of the Philistine , were dismayed, and greatly afraid.
text_la: Audiens autem Saul et omnes Israëlitæ sermones Philisthæi hujuscemodi, stupebant, et metuebant nimis.
text_pt: Ouvindo então Saul e todo o Israel estas palavras do filisteu, espantaram-se, e temeram muito.
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσεν Σαουλ καὶ πᾶς Ισραηλ τὰ ῥήματα τοῦ ἀλλοφύλου ταῦτα καὶ ἐξέστησαν καὶ ἐφοβήθησαν σφόδρα

text_en: Now David was the son of that Ephrathite , of Bethlehem Juda , before mentioned, whose name was Isai, who had eight sons, and was an old man in the days of Saul , and of great age among men .
text_la: David autem erat filius viri Ephrathæi, de quo supra dictum est, de Bethlehem Juda, cui nomen erat Isai, qui habebat octo filios, et erat vir in diebus Saul senex, et grandævus inter viros.
text_pt: E Davi era filho de um homem efrateu, de Belém de Judá, cujo nome era Jessé, que tinha oito filhos; e nos dias de Saul era este homem já velho e adiantado em idade entre os homens.

text_en: And his three eldest sons followed Saul to the battle: and the names of his three sons that went to the battle, were Eliab, the firstborn , and the second, Abinadab, and the third Samma:
text_la: Abierunt autem tres filii ejus majores post Saul in prælium : et nomina trium filiorum ejus qui perrexerunt ad bellum, Eliab primogenitus, et secundus Abinadab, tertiusque Samma.
text_pt: Foram-se os três filhos mais velhos de Jessé, e seguiram a Saul à guerra; e eram os nomes de seus três filhos, que se foram à guerra, Eliabe, o primogênito, e o segundo Abinadabe, e o terceiro Sama.

text_en: But David was the youngest. So the three eldest having followed Saul ,
text_la: David autem erat minimus. Tribus ergo majoribus secutis Saulem,
text_pt: E Davi era o menor; e os três maiores seguiram a Saul.

text_en: David went, and returned from Saul , to feed his father's flock at Bethlehem .
text_la: abiit David, et reversus est a Saul ut pasceret gregem patris sui in Bethlehem.
text_pt: Davi, porém, ia e voltava de Saul, para apascentar as ovelhas de seu pai em Belém.

text_en: Now the Philistine came out morning and evening, and presented himself forty days.
text_la: Procedebat vero Philisthæus mane et vespere, et stabat quadraginta diebus.
text_pt: Chegava-se, pois, o filisteu pela manhã e à tarde; e apresentou-se por quarenta dias.

text_en: And Isai said to David , his son: Take for your brethren an ephi of frumenty, and these ten loaves, and run to the camp to your brethren,
text_la: Dixit autem Isai ad David filium suum : Accipe fratribus tuis ephi polentæ, et decem panes istos, et curre in castra ad fratres tuos,
text_pt: E disse Jessé a Davi, seu filho: Toma, peço-te, para teus irmãos um efa deste grão tostado e estes dez pães, e corre a levá-los ao arraial, a teus irmãos.

text_en: and carry these ten little cheeses to the tribune: and go see your brethren, if they are well: and learn with whom they are placed.
text_la: et decem formellas casei has deferes ad tribunum : et fratres tuos visitabis, si recte agant : et cum quibus ordinati sunt, disce.
text_pt: Porém estes dez queijos de leite leva ao capitão de mil; e visitarás a teus irmãos, a ver se vão bem; e tomarás o seu penhor.

text_en: But Saul , and they, and all the children of Israel , were in the valley of Terebinth, fighting against the Philistines .
text_la: Saul autem, et illi, et omnes filii Israël, in Valle terebinthi pugnabant adversum Philisthiim.
text_pt: E estavam Saul, e eles, e todos os homens de Israel no vale do carvalho, pelejando com os filisteus.

text_en: David , therefore, arose in the morning, and gave the charge of the flock to the keeper: and went away loaded, as Isai had commanded him. And he came to the place of Magala, and to the army, which was going out to fight, and shouted for the battle.
text_la: Surrexit itaque David mane, et commendavit gregem custodi : et onustus abiit, sicut præceperat ei Isai. Et venit ad locum Magala, et ad exercitum, qui egressus ad pugnam vociferatus erat in certamine.
text_pt: Davi então se levantou de madrugada, pela manhã, e deixou as ovelhas com um guarda, e carregou-se, e partiu, como Jessé lhe ordenara; e chegou ao lugar dos carros, quando já o exército saía em ordem de batalha, e a gritos chamavam à peleja.

text_en: For Israel had put themselves in array, and the Philistines who stood against them were prepared.
text_la: Direxerat enim aciem Israël, sed et Philisthiim ex adverso fuerant præparati.
text_pt: E os israelitas e filisteus se puseram em ordem, fileira contra fileira.

text_en: And David leaving the vessels which he had brought, under the care of the keeper of the baggage, ran to the place of the battle, and asked if all things went well with his brethren.
text_la: Derelinquens ergo David vasa quæ attulerat sub manu custodis ad sarcinas, cucurrit ad locum certaminis, et interrogabat si omnia recte agerentur erga fratres suos.
text_pt: E Davi deixou a carga que trouxera na mão do guarda da bagagem, e correu à batalha; e, chegando, perguntou a seus irmãos se estavam bem.

text_en: And as he talked with them, that baseborn man , whose name was Goliath, the Philistine , of Geth, showed himself coming up from the camp of the Philistines : and he spoke according to the same words, and David heard them,
text_la: Cumque adhuc ille loqueretur eis, apparuit vir ille spurius ascendens, Goliath nomine, Philisthæus de Geth, de castris Philisthinorum : et loquente eo hæc eadem verba audivit David.
text_pt: E, estando ele ainda falando com eles, eis que vinha subindo do exército dos filisteus o homem guerreiro, cujo nome era Golias, o filisteu de Gate; e falou conforme àquelas palavras, e Davi as ouviu.

text_en: and all the Israelites , when they saw the man , fled from his face, fearing him exceedingly.
text_la: Omnes autem Israëlitæ, cum vidissent virum, fugerunt a facie ejus, timentes eum valde.
text_pt: Porém todos os homens em Israel, vendo aquele homem, fugiram de diante dele, e temiam grandemente.

text_en: And some one of Israel said: Have you seen this man that has come up, for he has come up to defy Israel . And the man that shall slay him, the king will enrich with great riches , and will give him his daughter, and will make his father's house free from tribute in Israel .
text_la: Et dixit unus quispiam de Israël : Num vidistis virum hunc, qui ascendit? ad exprobrandum enim Israëli ascendit. Virum ergo qui percusserit eum, ditabit rex divitiis magnis, et filiam suam dabit ei, et domum patris ejus faciet absque tributo in Israël.
text_pt: E diziam os homens de Israel: Vistes aquele homem que subiu? Pois subiu para afrontar a Israel; há de ser, pois, que, o homem que o ferir, o rei o enriquecerá de grandes riquezas, e lhe dará a sua filha, e fará livre a casa de seu pai em Israel.

text_en: And David spoke to the men that stood by him, saying: What shall be given to the man that shall kill this Philistine , and shall take away the reproach from Israel ? For who is this uncircumcised Philistine , that he should defy the armies of the living God ?
text_la: Et ait David ad viros qui stabant secum, dicens : Quid dabitur viro qui percusserit Philisthæum hunc, et tulerit opprobrium de Israël? quis enim est hic Philisthæus incircumcisus, qui exprobravit acies Dei viventis?
text_pt: Então falou Davi aos homens que estavam com ele, dizendo: Que farão àquele homem, que ferir a este filisteu, e tirar a afronta de sobre Israel? Quem é, pois, este incircunciso filisteu, para afrontar os exércitos do Deus vivo?

text_en: And the people answered him the same words, saying: These things shall be given to the man that shall slay him.
text_la: Referebat autem ei populus eumdem sermonem, dicens : Hæc dabuntur viro qui percusserit eum.
text_pt: E o povo lhe tornou a falar conforme àquela palavra dizendo: Assim farão ao homem que o ferir.

text_en: Now when Eliab his eldest brother heard this, when he was speaking with others, he was angry with David , and said: Why did you come here? And why did you leave those few sheep in the desert ? I know your pride , and the wickedness of your heart: that you have come down to see the battle.
text_la: Quod cum audisset Eliab frater ejus major, loquente eo cum aliis, iratus est contra David, et ait : Quare venisti, et quare dereliquisti pauculas oves illas in deserto? Ego novi superbiam tuam, et nequitiam cordis tui : quia ut videres prælium, descendisti.
text_pt: E, ouvindo Eliabe, seu irmão mais velho, falar àqueles homens, acendeu-se a ira de Eliabe contra Davi, e disse: Por que desceste aqui? Com quem deixaste aquelas poucas ovelhas no deserto? Bem conheço a tua presunção, e a maldade do teu coração, que desceste para ver a peleja.

text_en: And David said: What have I done? Is there not cause to speak?
text_la: Et dixit David : Quid feci? numquid non verbum est?
text_pt: Então disse Davi: Que fiz eu agora? Porventura não há razão para isso?

text_en: And he turned a little aside from him to another: and said the same word. And the people answered him as before.
text_la: Et declinavit paululum ab eo ad alium : dixitque eumdem sermonem. Et respondit ei populus verbum sicut prius.
text_pt: E desviou-se dele para outro, e falou conforme àquela palavra; e o povo lhe tornou a responder conforme às primeiras palavras.

text_en: And the words which David spoke were heard, and were rehearsed before Saul .
text_la: Audita sunt autem verba quæ locutus est David, et annuntiata in conspectu Saul.
text_pt: E, ouvidas as palavras que Davi havia falado, as anunciaram a Saul, que mandou chamá-lo.

text_en: And when he was brought to Saul , he said to him. Let not any man's heart be dismayed in him: I your servant will go, and will fight against the Philistine .
text_la: Ad quem cum fuisset adductus, locutus est ei : Non concidat cor cujusquam in eo : ego servus tuus vadam, et pugnabo adversus Philisthæum.
text_pt: E Davi disse a Saul: Não desfaleça o coração de ninguém por causa dele; teu servo irá, e pelejará contra este filisteu.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Δαυιδ πρὸς Σαουλ μὴ δὴ συμπεσέτω ἡ καρδία τοῦ κυρίου μου ἐπ' αὐτόν ὁ δοῦλός σου πορεύσεται καὶ πολεμήσει μετὰ τοῦ ἀλλοφύλου τούτου

text_en: And Saul said to David : You are not able to withstand this Philistine , nor to fight against him: for you are but a boy, but he is a warrior from his youth.
text_la: Et ait Saul ad David : Non vales resistere Philisthæo isti, nec pugnare adversus eum, quia puer es : hic autem vir bellator est ab adolescentia sua.
text_pt: Porém Saul disse a Davi: Contra este filisteu não poderás ir para pelejar com ele; pois tu ainda és moço, e ele homem de guerra desde a sua mocidade.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Σαουλ πρὸς Δαυιδ οὐ μὴ δυνήσῃ πορευθῆναι πρὸς τὸν ἀλλόφυλον τοῦ πολεμεῖν μετ' αὐτοῦ ὅτι παιδάριον εἶ σύ καὶ αὐτὸς ἀνὴρ πολεμιστὴς ἐκ νεότητος αὐτοῦ

text_en: And David said to Saul : Your servant kept his father's sheep, and there came a lion, or a bear, and took a ram out of the midst of the flock:
text_la: Dixitque David ad Saul : Pascebat servus tuus patris sui gregem, et veniebat leo vel ursus, et tollebat arietem de medio gregis:
text_pt: Então disse Davi a Saul: Teu servo apascentava as ovelhas de seu pai; e quando vinha um leão e um urso, e tomava uma ovelha do rebanho,
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Δαυιδ πρὸς Σαουλ ποιμαίνων ἦν ὁ δοῦλός σου τῷ πατρὶ αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ ποιμνίῳ καὶ ὅταν ἤρχετο ὁ λέων καὶ ἡ ἄρκος καὶ ἐλάμβανεν πρόβατον ἐκ τῆς ἀγέλης

text_en: And I pursued after them, and struck them, and delivered it out of their mouth: and they rose up against me, and I caught them by the throat, and I strangled, and killed them.
text_la: et persequebar eos, et percutiebam, eruebamque de ore eorum : et illi consurgebant adversum me, et apprehendebam mentum eorum, et suffocabam, interficiebamque eos.
text_pt: Eu saía após ele e o feria, e livrava-a da sua boca; e, quando ele se levantava contra mim, lançava-lhe mão da barba, e o feria e o matava.
text_el: καὶ ἐξεπορευόμην ὀπίσω αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπάταξα αὐτὸν καὶ ἐξέσπασα ἐκ τοῦ στόματος αὐτοῦ καὶ εἰ ἐπανίστατο ἐπ' ἐμέ καὶ ἐκράτησα τοῦ φάρυγγος αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπάταξα καὶ ἐθανάτωσα αὐτόν

text_en: For I your servant have killed both a lion and a bear: and this uncircumcised Philistine shall be also as one of them. I will go now, and take away the reproach of the people: for who is this uncircumcised Philistine , who has dared to curse the army of the living God ?
text_la: Nam et leonem et ursum interfeci ego servus tuus : erit igitur et Philisthæus hic incircumcisus quasi unus ex eis. Nunc vadam, et auferam opprobrium populi : quoniam quis est iste Philisthæus incircumcisus, qui ausus est maledicere exercitui Dei viventis?
text_pt: Assim feria o teu servo o leão, como o urso; assim será este incircunciso filisteu como um deles; porquanto afrontou os exércitos do Deus vivo.
text_el: καὶ τὴν ἄρκον ἔτυπτεν ὁ δοῦλός σου καὶ τὸν λέοντα καὶ ἔσται ὁ ἀλλόφυλος ὁ ἀπερίτμητος ὡς ἓν τούτων οὐχὶ πορεύσομαι καὶ πατάξω αὐτὸν καὶ ἀφελῶ σήμερον ὄνειδος ἐξ Ισραηλ διότι τίς ὁ ἀπερίτμητος οὗτος ὃς ὠνείδισεν παράταξιν θεοῦ ζῶντος

text_en: And David said: The Lord who delivered me out of the paw of the lion, and out of the paw of the bear, he will deliver me out of the hand of this Philistine . And Saul said to David : Go, and the Lord be with you.
text_la: Et ait David : Dominus qui eripuit me de manu leonis, et de manu ursi, ipse me liberabit de manu Philisthæi hujus. Dixit autem Saul ad David : Vade, et Dominus tecum sit.
text_pt: Disse mais Davi: O Senhor me livrou das garras do leão, e das do urso; ele me livrará da mão deste filisteu. Então disse Saul a Davi: Vai, e o Senhor seja contigo.
text_el: κύριος ὃς ἐξείλατό με ἐκ χειρὸς τοῦ λέοντος καὶ ἐκ χειρὸς τῆς ἄρκου αὐτὸς ἐξελεῖταί με ἐκ χειρὸς τοῦ ἀλλοφύλου τοῦ ἀπεριτμήτου τούτου καὶ εἶπεν Σαουλ πρὸς Δαυιδ πορεύου καὶ ἔσται κύριος μετὰ σοῦ

text_en: And Saul clothed David with his garments, and put a helmet of brass upon his head, and armed him with a coat of mail.
text_la: Et induit Saul David vestimentis suis, et imposuit galeam æream super caput ejus, et vestivit eum lorica.
text_pt: E Saul vestiu a Davi de suas vestes, e pôs-lhe sobre a cabeça um capacete de bronze; e o vestiu de uma couraça.
text_el: καὶ ἐνέδυσεν Σαουλ τὸν Δαυιδ μανδύαν καὶ περικεφαλαίαν χαλκῆν περὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And David having girded his sword upon his armour, began to try if he could walk in armour: for he was not accustomed to it. And David said to Saul : I cannot go thus, for I am not used to it. And he laid them off,
text_la: Accinctus ergo David gladio ejus super vestem suam, cœpit tentare si armatus posset incedere : non enim habebat consuetudinem. Dixitque David ad Saul : Non possum sic incedere, quia non usum habeo. Et deposuit ea,
text_pt: E Davi cingiu a espada sobre as suas vestes, e começou a andar; porém nunca o havia experimentado; então disse Davi a Saul: Não posso andar com isto, pois nunca o experimentei. E Davi tirou aquilo de sobre si.
text_el: καὶ ἔζωσεν τὸν Δαυιδ τὴν ῥομφαίαν αὐτοῦ ἐπάνω τοῦ μανδύου αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐκοπίασεν περιπατήσας ἅπαξ καὶ δίς καὶ εἶπεν Δαυιδ πρὸς Σαουλ οὐ μὴ δύνωμαι πορευθῆναι ἐν τούτοις ὅτι οὐ πεπείραμαι καὶ ἀφαιροῦσιν αὐτὰ ἀπ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: and he took his staff, which he had always in his hands: and chose him five smooth stones out of the brook, and put them into the shepherd's scrip, which he had with him, and he took a sling in his hand, and went forth against the Philistine .
text_la: et tulit baculum suum, quem semper habebat in manibus : et elegit sibi quinque limpidissimos lapides de torrente, et misit eos in peram pastoralem quam habebat secum, et fundam manu tulit : et processit adversum Philisthæum.
text_pt: E tomou o seu cajado na mão, e escolheu para si cinco seixos do ribeiro, e pô-los no alforje de pastor, que trazia, a saber, no surrão, e lançou mão da sua funda; e foi aproximando-se do filisteu.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν τὴν βακτηρίαν αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐξελέξατο ἑαυτῷ πέντε λίθους λείους ἐκ τοῦ χειμάρρου καὶ ἔθετο αὐτοὺς ἐν τῷ καδίῳ τῷ ποιμενικῷ τῷ ὄντι αὐτῷ εἰς συλλογὴν καὶ σφενδόνην αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ προσῆλθεν πρὸς τὸν ἄνδρα τὸν ἀλλόφυλον

text_en: And the Philistine came on, and drew near against David , and his armourbearer went before him.
text_la: Ibat autem Philisthæus incedens, et appropinquans adversum David, et armiger ejus ante eum.
text_pt: O filisteu também vinha se aproximando de Davi; e o que lhe levava o escudo ia adiante dele.

text_en: And when the Philistine looked, and beheld David , he despised him. For he was a young man, ruddy, and of a comely countenance.
text_la: Cumque inspexisset Philisthæus, et vidisset David, despexit eum. Erat enim adolescens, rufus, et pulcher aspectu.
text_pt: E, olhando o filisteu, e vendo a Davi, o desprezou, porquanto era moço, ruivo, e de gentil aspecto.
text_el: καὶ εἶδεν Γολιαδ τὸν Δαυιδ καὶ ἠτίμασεν αὐτόν ὅτι αὐτὸς ἦν παιδάριον καὶ αὐτὸς πυρράκης μετὰ κάλλους ὀφθαλμῶν

text_en: And the Philistine said to David : Am I a dog, that you come to me with a staff? And the Philistine cursed David by his gods.
text_la: Et dixit Philisthæus ad David : Numquid ego canis sum, quod tu venis ad me cum baculo? Et maledixit Philisthæus David in diis suis:
text_pt: Disse, pois, o filisteu a Davi: Sou eu algum cão, para tu vires a mim com paus? E o filisteu pelos seus deuses amaldiçoou a Davi.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ ἀλλόφυλος πρὸς Δαυιδ ὡσεὶ κύων ἐγώ εἰμι ὅτι σὺ ἔρχῃ ἐπ' ἐμὲ ἐν ῥάβδῳ καὶ λίθοις καὶ εἶπεν Δαυιδ οὐχί ἀλλ' ἢ χείρω κυνός καὶ κατηράσατο ὁ ἀλλόφυλος τὸν Δαυιδ ἐν τοῖς θεοῖς αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he said to David : Come to me, and I will give your flesh to the birds of the air, and to the beasts of the earth.
text_la: dixitque ad David : Veni ad me, et dabo carnes tuas volatilibus cæli et bestiis terræ.
text_pt: Disse mais o filisteu a Davi: Vem a mim, e darei a tua carne às aves do céu e às bestas do campo.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ ἀλλόφυλος πρὸς Δαυιδ δεῦρο πρός με καὶ δώσω τὰς σάρκας σου τοῖς πετεινοῖς τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ τοῖς κτήνεσιν τῆς γῆς

text_en: And David said to the Philistine : You come to me with a sword, and with a spear, and with a shield: but I come to you in the name of the Lord of hosts , the God of the armies of Israel , which you have defied.
text_la: Dixit autem David ad Philisthæum : Tu venis ad me cum gladio, et hasta, et clypeo : ego autem venio ad te in nomine Domini exercituum, Dei agminum Israël quibus exprobrasti
text_pt: Davi, porém, disse ao filisteu: Tu vens a mim com espada, e com lança, e com escudo; porém eu venho a ti em nome do Senhor dos Exércitos, o Deus dos exércitos de Israel, a quem tens afrontado.
text_el: καὶ εἰπεν Δαυιδ πρὸς τὸν ἀλλόφυλον σὺ ἔρχῃ πρός με ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ καὶ ἐν δόρατι καὶ ἐν ἀσπίδι κἀγὼ πορεύομαι πρὸς σὲ ἐν ὀνόματι κυρίου σαβαωθ θεοῦ παρατάξεως Ισραηλ ἣν ὠνείδισας σήμερον

text_en: This day, and the Lord will deliver you into my hand, and I will slay you, and take away your head from you: and I will give the carcasses of the army of the Philistines this day to the birds of the air, and to the beasts of the earth: that all the earth may know that there is a God in Israel .
text_la: hodie, et dabit te Dominus in manu mea, et percutiam te, et auferam caput tuum a te : et dabo cadavera castrorum Philisthiim hodie volatilibus cæli, et bestiis terræ, ut sciat omnis terra quia est Deus in Israël,
text_pt: Hoje mesmo o Senhor te entregará na minha mão, e ferir-te-ei, e tirar-te-ei a cabeça, e os corpos do arraial dos filisteus darei hoje mesmo às aves do céu e às feras da terra; e toda a terra saberá que há Deus em Israel;
text_el: καὶ ἀποκλείσει σε κύριος σήμερον εἰς τὴν χεῖρά μου καὶ ἀποκτενῶ σε καὶ ἀφελῶ τὴν κεφαλήν σου ἀπὸ σοῦ καὶ δώσω τὰ κῶλά σου καὶ τὰ κῶλα παρεμβολῆς ἀλλοφύλων ἐν ταύτῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τοῖς πετεινοῖς τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ τοῖς θηρίοις τῆς γῆς καὶ γνώσεται πᾶσα ἡ γῆ ὅτι ἔστιν θεὸς ἐν Ισραηλ

text_en: And all this assembly shall know that the Lord saves not with sword and spear: for it is his battle, and he will deliver you into our hands.
text_la: et noverit universa ecclesia hæc, quia non in gladio nec in hasta salvat Dominus : ipsius enim est bellum, et tradet vos in manus nostras.
text_pt: E saberá toda esta congregação que o Senhor salva, não com espada, nem com lança; porque do Senhor é a guerra, e ele vos entregará na nossa mão.
text_el: καὶ γνώσεται πᾶσα ἡ ἐκκλησία αὕτη ὅτι οὐκ ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ καὶ δόρατι σῴζει κύριος ὅτι τοῦ κυρίου ὁ πόλεμος καὶ παραδώσει κύριος ὑμᾶς εἰς χεῖρας ἡμῶν

text_en: And when the Philistine arose, and was coming, and drew near to meet David , David made haste, and ran to the fight to meet the Philistine .
text_la: Cum ergo surrexisset Philisthæus, et veniret, et appropinquaret contra David, festinavit David et cucurrit ad pugnam ex adverso Philisthæi.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, levantando-se o filisteu, e indo encontrar-se com Davi, apressou-se Davi, e correu ao combate, a encontrar-se com o filisteu.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέστη ὁ ἀλλόφυλος καὶ ἐπορεύθη εἰς συνάντησιν Δαυιδ

text_en: And he put his hand into his scrip, and took a stone, and cast it with the sling, and fetching it about, struck the Philistine in the forehead, and he fell on his face upon the earth.
text_la: Et misit manum suam in peram, tulitque unum lapidem, et funda jecit, et circumducens percussit Philisthæum in fronte : et infixus est lapis in fronte ejus, et cecidit in faciem suam super terram.
text_pt: E Davi pôs a mão no alforje, e tomou dali uma pedra e com a funda lha atirou, e feriu o filisteu na testa, e a pedra se lhe encravou na testa, e caiu sobre o seu rosto em terra.
text_el: καὶ ἐξέτεινεν Δαυιδ τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸ κάδιον καὶ ἔλαβεν ἐκεῖθεν λίθον ἕνα καὶ ἐσφενδόνησεν καὶ ἐπάταξεν τὸν ἀλλόφυλον ἐπὶ τὸ μέτωπον αὐτοῦ καὶ διέδυ ὁ λίθος διὰ τῆς περικεφαλαίας εἰς τὸ μέτωπον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔπεσεν ἐπὶ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν

text_en: And David prevailed over the Philistine , with a sling and a stone, and he struck, and slew the Philistine . And as David had no sword in his hand,
text_la: Prævaluitque David adversum Philisthæum in funda et lapide, percussumque Philisthæum interfecit. Cumque gladium non haberet in manu David,
text_pt: Assim Davi prevaleceu contra o filisteu, com uma funda e com uma pedra, e feriu o filisteu, e o matou; sem que Davi tivesse uma espada na mão.

text_en: he ran, and stood over the Philistine , and took his sword, and drew it out of the sheath, and slew him, and cut off his head. And the Philistines seeing that their champion was dead, fled away.
text_la: cucurrit, et stetit super Philisthæum, et tulit gladium ejus, et eduxit eum de vagina sua : et interfecit eum, præciditque caput ejus. Videntes autem Philisthiim quod mortuus esset fortissimus eorum, fugerunt.
text_pt: Por isso correu Davi, e pôs-se em pé sobre o filisteu, e tomou a sua espada, e tirou-a da bainha, e o matou, e lhe cortou com ela a cabeça; vendo então os filisteus, que o seu herói era morto, fugiram.
text_el: καὶ ἔδραμεν Δαυιδ καὶ ἐπέστη ἐπ' αὐτὸν καὶ ἔλαβεν τὴν ῥομφαίαν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐθανάτωσεν αὐτὸν καὶ ἀφεῖλεν τὴν κεφαλὴν αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶδον οἱ ἀλλόφυλοι ὅτι τέθνηκεν ὁ δυνατὸς αὐτῶν καὶ ἔφυγον

text_en: And the men of Israel and Juda rising up shouted, and pursued after the Philistines till they came to the valley and to the gates of Accaron , and there fell many wounded of the Philistines in the way of Saraim, and as far as Geth, and as far as Accaron .
text_la: Et consurgentes viri Israël et Juda vociferati sunt, et persecuti sunt Philisthæos usque dum venirent in vallem, et usque ad portas Accaron : cecideruntque vulnerati de Philisthiim in via Saraim, et usque ad Geth, et usque ad Accaron.
text_pt: Então os homens de Israel e Judá se levantaram, e jubilaram, e seguiram os filisteus, até chegar ao vale, e até às portas de Ecrom; e caíram os feridos dos filisteus pelo caminho de Saaraim até Gate e até Ecrom.
text_el: καὶ ἀνίστανται ἄνδρες Ισραηλ καὶ Ιουδα καὶ ἠλάλαξαν καὶ κατεδίωξαν ὀπίσω αὐτῶν ἕως εἰσόδου Γεθ καὶ ἕως τῆς πύλης Ἀσκαλῶνος καὶ ἔπεσαν τραυματίαι τῶν ἀλλοφύλων ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ τῶν πυλῶν καὶ ἕως Γεθ καὶ ἕως Ακκαρων

text_en: And the children of Israel returning, after they had pursued the Philistines , fell upon their camp.
text_la: Et revertentes filii Israël postquam persecuti fuerant Philisthæos, invaserunt castra eorum.
text_pt: Então voltaram os filhos de Israel de perseguirem os filisteus, e despojaram os seus arraiais.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέστρεψαν ἄνδρες Ισραηλ ἐκκλίνοντες ὀπίσω τῶν ἀλλοφύλων καὶ κατεπάτουν τὰς παρεμβολὰς αὐτῶν

text_en: And David taking the head of the Philistine , brought it to Jerusalem : but his armour he put in his tent.
text_la: Assumens autem David caput Philisthæi, attulit illud in Jerusalem : arma vero ejus posuit in tabernaculo suo.
text_pt: E Davi tomou a cabeça do filisteu, e a trouxe a Jerusalém; porém pôs as armas dele na sua tenda.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν Δαυιδ τὴν κεφαλὴν τοῦ ἀλλοφύλου καὶ ἤνεγκεν αὐτὴν εἰς Ιερουσαλημ καὶ τὰ σκεύη αὐτοῦ ἔθηκεν ἐν τῷ σκηνώματι αὐτοῦ

text_en: Now at the time that Saul saw David going out against the Philistines , he said to Abner , the captain of the army: Of what family is this young man descended, Abner ? And Abner said: As your soul lives, O king, I know not.
text_la: Eo autem tempore quo viderat Saul David egredientem contra Philisthæum, ait ad Abner principem militiæ : De qua stirpe descendit hic adolescens, Abner? Dixitque Abner : Vivit anima tua, rex, si novi.
text_pt: Vendo, porém, Saul, sair Davi a encontrar-se com o filisteu, disse a Abner, o capitão do exército: De quem é filho este moço, Abner? E disse Abner: Vive a tua alma, ó rei, que o não sei.

text_en: And the king said: Inquire, whose son this young man is.
text_la: Et ait rex : Interroga tu, cujus filius sit iste puer.
text_pt: Disse então o rei: Pergunta, pois, de quem é filho este moço.

text_en: And when David was returned, after the Philistine was slain, Abner took him, and brought him in before Saul , with the head of the Philistine in his hand.
text_la: Cumque regressus esset David, percusso Philisthæo, tulit eum Abner, et introduxit coram Saule, caput Philisthæi habentem in manu.
text_pt: Voltando, pois, Davi de ferir o filisteu, Abner o tomou consigo, e o trouxe à presença de Saul, trazendo ele na mão a cabeça do filisteu.

text_en: And Saul said to him: Young man , of what family are you? And David said: I am the son of your servant Isai the Bethlehemite .
text_la: Et ait ad eum Saul : De qua progenie es, o adolescens? Dixitque David : Filius servi tui Isai Bethlehemitæ ego sum.
text_pt: E disse-lhe Saul: De quem és filho, jovem? E disse Davi: Filho de teu servo Jessé, belemita.

text_en: And it came to pass, when he had made an end of speaking to Saul , the son of Jonathan was knit with the soul of David , and Jonathan loved him as his own soul .
text_la: Et factum est cum complesset loqui ad Saul, anima Jonathæ conglutinata est animæ David, et dilexit eum Jonathas quasi animam suam.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, acabando ele de falar com Saul, a alma de Jônatas se ligou com a alma de Davi; e Jônatas o amou, como à sua própria alma.

text_en: And Saul took him that day, and would not let him return to his father's house.
text_la: Tulitque eum Saul in die illa, et non concessit ei ut reverteretur in domum patris sui.
text_pt: E Saul naquele dia o tomou, e não lhe permitiu que voltasse para casa de seu pai.

text_en: And David and Jonathan made a covenant, for he loved him as his own soul .
text_la: Inierunt autem David et Jonathas fœdus : diligebat enim eum quasi animam suam.
text_pt: E Jônatas e Davi fizeram aliança; porque Jônatas o amava como à sua própria alma.

text_en: And Jonathan stripped himself of the coat with which he was clothed, and gave it to David , and the rest of his garments, even to his sword, and to his bow, and to his girdle.
text_la: Nam expoliavit se Jonathas tunica qua erat indutus, et dedit eam David, et reliqua vestimenta sua, usque ad gladium et arcum suum, et usque ad balteum.
text_pt: E Jônatas se despojou da capa que trazia sobre si, e a deu a Davi, como também as suas vestes, até a sua espada, e o seu arco, e o seu cinto.

text_en: And David went out to whatsoever business Saul sent him, and he behaved himself prudently: and Saul set him over the soldiers, and he was acceptable in the eyes of all the people, and especially in the eyes of Saul's servants.
text_la: Egrediebatur quoque David ad omnia quæcumque misisset eum Saul, et prudenter se agebat : posuitque eum Saul super viros belli, et acceptus erat in oculis universi populi, maximeque in conspectu famulorum Saul.
text_pt: E saía Davi aonde quer que Saul o enviasse e conduzia-se com prudência, e Saul o pôs sobre os homens de guerra; e era aceito aos olhos de todo o povo, e até aos olhos dos servos de Saul.

text_en: Now when David returned, after he slew the Philistine , the women came out of all the cities of Israel , singing and dancing , to meet King Saul , with timbrels of joy , and cornets.
text_la: Porro cum reverteretur percusso Philisthæo David, egressæ sunt mulieres de universis urbibus Israël, cantantes, chorosque ducentes in occursum Saul regis, in tympanis lætitiæ, et in sistris.
text_pt: Sucedeu, porém, que, vindo eles, quando Davi voltava de ferir os filisteus, as mulheres de todas as cidades de Israel saíram ao encontro do rei Saul, cantando e dançando, com adufes, com alegria, e com instrumentos de música.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθον αἱ χορεύουσαι εἰς συνάντησιν Δαυιδ ἐκ πασῶν πόλεων Ισραηλ ἐν τυμπάνοις καὶ ἐν χαρμοσύνῃ καὶ ἐν κυμβάλοις

text_en: And the women sung as they played, and they said: Saul slew his thousands, and David his ten thousands.
text_la: Et præcinebant mulieres, ludentes, atque dicentes :Percussit Saul mille, et David decem millia.
text_pt: E as mulheres dançando e cantando se respondiam umas às outras, dizendo: Saul feriu os seus milhares, porém, Davi os seus dez milhares.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆρχον αἱ γυναῖκες καὶ ἔλεγον ἐπάταξεν Σαουλ ἐν χιλιάσιν αὐτοῦ καὶ Δαυιδ ἐν μυριάσιν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Saul was exceeding angry , and this word was displeasing in his eyes, and he said: They have given David ten thousands, and to me they have given but a thousand, what can he have more but the kingdom?
text_la: Iratus est autem Saul nimis, et displicuit in oculis ejus sermo iste : dixitque : Dederunt David decem millia, et mihi mille dederunt : quid ei superest, nisi solum regnum?
text_pt: Então Saul se indignou muito, e aquela palavra pareceu mal aos seus olhos, e disse: Dez milhares deram a Davi, e a mim somente milhares; na verdade, que lhe falta, senão só o reino?
text_el: καὶ πονηρὸν ἐφάνη τὸ ῥῆμα ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς Σαουλ περὶ τοῦ λόγου τούτου καὶ εἶπεν τῷ Δαυιδ ἔδωκαν τὰς μυριάδας καὶ ἐμοὶ ἔδωκαν τὰς χιλιάδας

text_en: And Saul did not look on David with a good eye from that day and forward.
text_la: Non rectis ergo oculis Saul aspiciebat David a die illa et deinceps.
text_pt: E, desde aquele dia em diante, Saul tinha Davi em suspeita.
text_el: καὶ ἦν Σαουλ ὑποβλεπόμενος τὸν Δαυιδ ἀπὸ τῆς ἡμέρας ἐκείνης καὶ ἐπέκεινα

text_en: And the day after, the evil spirit from God came upon Saul , and he prophesied in the midst of his house. And David played with his hand as at other times. And Saul held a spear in his hand,
text_la: Post diem autem alteram, invasit spiritus Dei malus Saul, et prophetabat in medio domus suæ : David autem psallebat manu sua, sicut per singulos dies. Tenebatque Saul lanceam,
text_pt: E aconteceu no outro dia, que o mau espírito da parte de Deus se apoderou de Saul, e profetizava no meio da casa; e Davi tocava a harpa com a sua mão, como nos outros dias; Saul, porém, tinha na mão uma lança.

text_en: and threw it, thinking to nail David to the wall: and David stept aside out of his presence twice.
text_la: et misit eam, putans quod configere posset David cum pariete : et declinavit David a facie ejus secundo.
text_pt: E Saul atirou com a lança, dizendo: Encravarei a Davi na parede. Porém Davi se desviou dele por duas vezes.

text_en: And Saul feared David , because the Lord was with him, and was departed from Saul himself.
text_la: Et timuit Saul David, eo quod Dominus esset cum eo, et a se recessisset.
text_pt: E temia Saul a Davi, porque o Senhor era com ele e se tinha retirado de Saul.
text_el: καὶ ἐφοβήθη Σαουλ ἀπὸ προσώπου Δαυιδ

text_en: Therefore Saul removed him from him, and made him a captain over a thousand men , and he went out and came in before the people.
text_la: Amovit ergo eum Saul a se, et fecit eum tribunum super mille viros : et egrediebatur, et intrabat in conspectu populi.
text_pt: Por isso Saul o desviou de si, e o pôs por capitão de mil; e saía e entrava diante do povo.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστησεν αὐτὸν ἀπ' αὐτοῦ καὶ κατέστησεν αὐτὸν ἑαυτῷ χιλίαρχον καὶ ἐξεπορεύετο καὶ εἰσεπορεύετο ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ λαοῦ

text_en: And David behaved wisely in all his ways, and the Lord was with him.
text_la: In omnibus quoque viis suis David prudenter agebat, et Dominus erat cum eo.
text_pt: E Davi se conduzia com prudência em todos os seus caminhos, e o Senhor era com ele.
text_el: καὶ ἦν Δαυιδ ἐν πάσαις ταῖς ὁδοῖς αὐτοῦ συνίων καὶ κύριος μετ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Saul saw that he was exceeding prudent, and began to beware of him.
text_la: Vidit itaque Saul quod prudens esset nimis, et cœpit cavere eum.
text_pt: Vendo então Saul que tão prudentemente se conduzia, tinha receio dele.
text_el: καὶ εἶδεν Σαουλ ὡς αὐτὸς συνίει σφόδρα καὶ εὐλαβεῖτο ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτοῦ

text_en: But all Israel and Juda loved David , for he came in and went out before them.
text_la: Omnis autem Israël et Juda diligebat David : ipse enim ingrediebatur et egrediebatur ante eos.
text_pt: Porém todo o Israel e Judá amava a Davi, porquanto saía e entrava diante deles.
text_el: καὶ πᾶς Ισραηλ καὶ Ιουδας ἠγάπα τὸν Δαυιδ ὅτι αὐτὸς ἐξεπορεύετο καὶ εἰσεπορεύετο πρὸ προσώπου τοῦ λαοῦ

text_en: And Saul said to David : Behold my elder daughter Merob, her will I give you to wife: only be a valiant man , and fight the battles of the Lord . Now Saul said within himself: Let not my hand be upon him, but let the hands of the Philistines be upon him.
text_la: Dixitque Saul ad David : Ecce filia mea major Merob : ipsam dabo tibi uxorem : tantummodo esto vir fortis, et præliare bella Domini. Saul autem reputabat, dicens : Non sit manus mea in eum, sed sit super eum manus Philisthinorum.
text_pt: Por isso Saul disse a Davi: Eis que Merabe, minha filha mais velha, te darei por mulher; sê-me somente filho valoroso, e guerreia as guerras do Senhor (porque Saul dizia consigo: Não seja contra ele a minha mão, mas sim a dos filisteus).

text_en: And David said to Saul : Who am I, or what is my life, or my father's family in Israel , that I should be son in law of the king?
text_la: Ait autem David ad Saul : Quis ego sum, aut quæ est vita mea, aut cognatio patris mei in Israël, ut fiam gener regis?
text_pt: Mas Davi disse a Saul: Quem sou eu, e qual é a minha vida e a família de meu pai em Israel, para vir a ser genro do rei?

text_en: And it came to pass at the time when Merob, the daughter of Saul , should have been given to David , that she was given to Hadriel, the Molathite, to wife.
text_la: Factum est autem tempus cum deberet dari Merob filia Saul David, data est Hadrieli Molathitæ uxor.
text_pt: Sucedeu, porém, que ao tempo que Merabe, filha de Saul, devia ser dada a Davi, ela foi dada por mulher a Adriel, meolatita.

text_en: But Michol, the other daughter of Saul , loved David . And it was told Saul , and it pleased him.
text_la: Dilexit autem David Michol filia Saul altera. Et nuntiatum est Saul, et placuit ei.
text_pt: Mas Mical, a outra filha de Saul amava a Davi; o que, sendo anunciado a Saul, pareceu isto bom aos seus olhos.
text_el: καὶ ἠγάπησεν Μελχολ ἡ θυγάτηρ Σαουλ τὸν Δαυιδ καὶ ἀπηγγέλη Σαουλ καὶ ηὐθύνθη ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Saul said: I will give her to him, that she may be a stumbling block to him, and that the hand of the Philistines may be upon him. And Saul said to David : In two things you shall be my son in law this day.
text_la: Dixitque Saul : Dabo eam illi, ut fiat ei in scandalum, et sit super eum manus Philisthinorum. Dixitque Saul ad David : In duabus rebus gener meus eris hodie.
text_pt: E Saul disse: Eu lha darei, para que lhe sirva de laço, e para que a mão dos filisteus venha a ser contra ele. Pelo que Saul disse a Davi: Com a outra serás hoje meu genro.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Σαουλ δώσω αὐτὴν αὐτῷ καὶ ἔσται αὐτῷ εἰς σκάνδαλον καὶ ἦν ἐπὶ Σαουλ χεὶρ ἀλλοφύλων

text_en: And Saul commanded his servants to speak to David privately, saying: Behold, you please the king, and all his servants love you. Now, therefore be the king's son in law.
text_la: Et mandavit Saul servis suis : Loquimini ad David clam me, dicentes : Ecce places regi, et omnes servi ejus diligunt te : nunc ergo esto gener regis.
text_pt: E Saul deu ordem aos seus servos: Falai em segredo a Davi, dizendo: Eis que o rei te está mui afeiçoado, e todos os seus servos te amam; agora, pois, consente em ser genro do rei.
text_el: καὶ ἐνετείλατο Σαουλ τοῖς παισὶν αὐτοῦ λέγων λαλήσατε ὑμεῖς λάθρᾳ τῷ Δαυιδ λέγοντες ἰδοὺ ὁ βασιλεὺς θέλει ἐν σοί καὶ πάντες οἱ παῖδες αὐτοῦ ἀγαπῶσίν σε καὶ σὺ ἐπιγάμβρευσον τῷ βασιλεῖ

text_en: And the servants of Saul spoke all these words in the ear of David . And David said: Does it seem to you a small matter to be the king's son in law? But I am a poor man , and of small ability.
text_la: Et locuti sunt servi Saul in auribus David omnia verba hæc. Et ait David : Num parum videtur vobis, generum esse regis? ego autem sum vir pauper et tenuis.
text_pt: E os servos de Saul falaram todas estas palavras aos ouvidos de Davi. Então disse Davi: Parece-vos pouco aos vossos olhos ser genro do rei, sendo eu homem pobre e desprezível?
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησαν οἱ παῖδες Σαουλ εἰς τὰ ὦτα Δαυιδ τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα καὶ εἶπεν Δαυιδ εἰ κοῦφον ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς ὑμῶν ἐπιγαμβρεῦσαι βασιλεῖ κἀγὼ ἀνὴρ ταπεινὸς καὶ οὐχὶ ἔνδοξος

text_en: And the servants of Saul told him, saying: Such words as these has David spoken.
text_la: Et renuntiaverunt servi Saul dicentes: Hujuscemodi verba locutus est David.
text_pt: E os servos de Saul lhe anunciaram isto, dizendo: Foram tais as palavras que falou Davi.
text_el: καὶ ἀπήγγειλαν οἱ παῖδες Σαουλ αὐτῷ κατὰ τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα ἃ ἐλάλησεν Δαυιδ

text_en: And Saul said: Speak thus to David : The king desires not any dowry, but only a hundred foreskins of the Philistines , to be avenged of the king's enemies. Now Saul thought to deliver David into the hands of the Philistines .
text_la: Dixit autem Saul : Sic loquimini ad David : Non habet rex sponsalia necesse, nisi tantum centum præputia Philisthinorum, ut fiat ultio de inimicis regis. Porro Saul cogitabat tradere David in manus Philisthinorum.
text_pt: Então disse Saul: Assim direis a Davi: O rei não tem necessidade de dote, senão de cem prepúcios de filisteus, para se tomar vingança dos inimigos do rei. Porquanto Saul tentava fazer cair a Davi pela mão dos filisteus.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Σαουλ τάδε ἐρεῖτε τῷ Δαυιδ οὐ βούλεται ὁ βασιλεὺς ἐν δόματι ἀλλ' ἢ ἐν ἑκατὸν ἀκροβυστίαις ἀλλοφύλων ἐκδικῆσαι εἰς ἐχθροὺς τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ Σαουλ ἐλογίσατο αὐτὸν ἐμβαλεῖν εἰς χεῖρας τῶν ἀλλοφύλων

text_en: And when his servants had told David the words that Saul had said, the word was pleasing in the eyes of David to be the king's son in law.
text_la: Cumque renuntiassent servi ejus David verba quæ dixerat Saul, placuit sermo in oculis David, ut fieret gener regis.
text_pt: E anunciaram os seus servos estas palavras a Davi, e este negócio pareceu bem aos olhos de Davi, de que fosse genro do rei; porém ainda os dias não se haviam cumprido.
text_el: καὶ ἀπαγγέλλουσιν οἱ παῖδες Σαουλ τῷ Δαυιδ τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα καὶ εὐθύνθη ὁ λόγος ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς Δαυιδ ἐπιγαμβρεῦσαι τῷ βασιλεῖ

text_en: And after a few days David rose up, and went with the men that were under him, and he slew of the Philistines two hundred men , and brought their foreskins and numbered them out to the king, that he might be his son in law. Saul therefore gave him Michol, his daughter, to wife.
text_la: Et post paucos dies surgens David, abiit cum viris qui sub eo erant. Et percussit ex Philisthiim ducentos viros, et attulit eorum præputia et annumeravit ea regi, ut esset gener ejus. Dedit itaque Saul ei Michol filiam suam uxorem.
text_pt: Então Davi se levantou, e partiu com os seus homens, e feriu dentre os filisteus duzentos homens, e Davi trouxe os seus prepúcios, e os entregou todos ao rei, para que fosse genro do rei; então Saul lhe deu por mulher a sua filha.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέστη Δαυιδ καὶ ἐπορεύθη αὐτὸς καὶ οἱ ἄνδρες αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπάταξεν ἐν τοῖς ἀλλοφύλοις ἑκατὸν ἄνδρας καὶ ἀνήνεγκεν τὰς ἀκροβυστίας αὐτῶν τῷ βασιλεῖ καὶ ἐπιγαμβρεύεται τῷ βασιλεῖ καὶ δίδωσιν αὐτῷ τὴν Μελχολ θυγατέρα αὐτοῦ αὐτῷ εἰς γυναῖκα

text_en: And Saul saw, and understood that the Lord was with David . And Michol, the daughter of Saul , loved him.
text_la: Et vidit Saul, et intellexit quod Dominus esset cum David. Michol autem filia Saul diligebat eum.
text_pt: E viu Saul, e notou que o Senhor era com Davi; e Mical, filha de Saul, o amava.
text_el: καὶ εἶδεν Σαουλ ὅτι κύριος μετὰ Δαυιδ καὶ πᾶς Ισραηλ ἠγάπα αὐτόν

text_en: And Saul began to fear David more: and Saul became David's enemy continually.
text_la: Et Saul magis cœpit timere David : factusque est Saul inimicus David cunctis diebus.
text_pt: Então Saul temeu muito mais a Davi; e Saul foi todos os seus dias inimigo de Davi.
text_el: καὶ προσέθετο εὐλαβεῖσθαι ἀπὸ Δαυιδ ἔτι

text_en: And the princes of the Philistines went forth: and from the beginning of their going forth, David behaved himself more wisely than all the servants of Saul , and his name became very famous.
text_la: Et egressi sunt principes Philisthinorum. A principio autem egressionis eorum, prudentius se gerebat David quam omnes servi Saul, et celebre factum est nomen ejus nimis.
text_pt: E, saindo os príncipes dos filisteus à campanha, sucedia que Davi se conduzia com mais êxito do que todos os servos de Saul; portanto o seu nome era muito estimado.

text_en: And Saul spoke to Jonathan , his son, and to all his servants, that they should kill David . But Jonathan , the son of Saul , loved David exceedingly.
text_la: Locutus est autem Saul ad Jonathan filium suum, et ad omnes servos suos, ut occiderent David. Porro Jonathas filius Saul diligebat David valde:
text_pt: E falou Saul a Jônatas, seu filho, e a todos os seus servos, para que matassem a Davi. Porém Jônatas, filho de Saul, estava mui afeiçoado a Davi.
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν Σαουλ πρὸς Ιωναθαν τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ πρὸς πάντας τοὺς παῖδας αὐτοῦ θανατῶσαι τὸν Δαυιδ καὶ Ιωναθαν υἱὸς Σαουλ ᾑρεῖτο τὸν Δαυιδ σφόδρα

text_en: And Jonathan told David , saying: Saul , my father, seeks to kill you: wherefore look to yourself, I beseech you, in the morning and you shall abide in a secret place, and shall be hid.
text_la: et indicavit Jonathas David, dicens : Quærit Saul pater meus occidere te : quapropter observa te, quæso, mane : et manebis clam, et absconderis.
text_pt: E Jônatas o anunciou a Davi, dizendo: Meu pai, Saul, procura matar-te, pelo que agora guarda-te pela manhã, e fica-te em oculto, e esconde-te.
text_el: καὶ ἀπήγγειλεν Ιωναθαν τῷ Δαυιδ λέγων Σαουλ ζητεῖ θανατῶσαί σε φύλαξαι οὖν αὔριον πρωὶ καὶ κρύβηθι καὶ κάθισον κρυβῇ

text_en: And I will go out and stand beside my father in the field where you are: and I will speak of you to my father, and whatsoever I shall see, I will tell you.
text_la: Ego autem egrediens stabo juxta patrem meum in agro, ubicumque fueris : et ego loquar de te ad patrem meum, et quodcumque videro, nuntiabo tibi.
text_pt: E sairei eu, e estarei à mão de meu pai no campo em que estiverdes, e eu falarei de ti a meu pai, e verei o que há, e to anunciarei.
text_el: καὶ ἐγὼ ἐξελεύσομαι καὶ στήσομαι ἐχόμενος τοῦ πατρός μου ἐν ἀγρῷ οὗ ἐὰν ᾖς ἐκεῖ καὶ ἐγὼ λαλήσω περὶ σοῦ πρὸς τὸν πατέρα μου καὶ ὄψομαι ὅ τι ἐὰν ᾖ καὶ ἀπαγγελῶ σοι

text_en: And Jonathan spoke good things of David to Saul , his father: and said to him: Sin not, O king, against your servant, David , because he has not sinned against you, and his works are very good towards you.
text_la: Locutus est ergo Jonathas de David bona ad Saul patrem suum : dixitque ad eum : Ne pecces rex in servum tuum David, quia non peccavit tibi, et opera ejus bona sunt tibi valde.
text_pt: Então Jônatas falou bem de Davi a Saul, seu pai, e disse-lhe: Não peque o rei contra seu servo Davi, porque ele não pecou contra ti, e porque os seus feitos te são muito bons.
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν Ιωναθαν περὶ Δαυιδ ἀγαθὰ πρὸς Σαουλ τὸν πατέρα αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτόν μὴ ἁμαρτησάτω ὁ βασιλεὺς εἰς τὸν δοῦλόν σου Δαυιδ ὅτι οὐχ ἡμάρτηκεν εἰς σέ καὶ τὰ ποιήματα αὐτοῦ ἀγαθὰ σφόδρα

text_en: And he put his life in his hand, and slew the Philistine , and the Lord wrought great salvation for all Israel . You saw it and rejoiced. Why therefore will you sin against innocent blood, by killing David , who is without fault?
text_la: Et posuit animam suam in manu sua, et percussit Philisthæum, et fecit Dominus salutem magnam universo Israëli : vidisti, et lætatus es. Quare ergo peccas in sanguine innoxio, interficiens David, qui est absque culpa?
text_pt: Porque expôs a sua vida, e feriu aos filisteus, e fez o Senhor um grande livramento a todo o Israel; tu mesmo o viste, e te alegraste; porque, pois, pecarias contra o sangue inocente, matando a Davi, sem causa?
text_el: καὶ ἔθετο τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπάταξεν τὸν ἀλλόφυλον καὶ ἐποίησεν κύριος σωτηρίαν μεγάλην καὶ πᾶς Ισραηλ εἶδον καὶ ἐχάρησαν καὶ ἵνα τί ἁμαρτάνεις εἰς αἷμα ἀθῷον θανατῶσαι τὸν Δαυιδ δωρεάν

text_en: And when Saul heard this, he was appeased with the words of Jonathan , and swore : As the Lord lives, he shall not be slain.
text_la: Quod cum audisset Saul, placatus voce Jonathæ, juravit : Vivit Dominus, quia non occidetur.
text_pt: E Saul deu ouvidos à voz de Jônatas, e jurou Saul: Vive o Senhor, que não morrerá.
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσεν Σαουλ τῆς φωνῆς Ιωναθαν καὶ ὤμοσεν Σαουλ λέγων ζῇ κύριος εἰ ἀποθανεῖται

text_en: Then Jonathan called David , and told him all these words: and Jonathan brought in David to Saul , and he was before him, as he had been yesterday and the day before.
text_la: Vocavit itaque Jonathas David, et indicavit ei omnia verba hæc : et introduxit Jonathas David ad Saul, et fuit ante eum sicut fuerat heri et nudiustertius.
text_pt: E Jônatas chamou a Davi, e contou-lhe todas estas palavras; e Jônatas levou Davi a Saul, e esteve perante ele como antes.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν Ιωναθαν τὸν Δαυιδ καὶ ἀπήγγειλεν αὐτῷ πάντα τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα καὶ εἰσήγαγεν Ιωναθαν τὸν Δαυιδ πρὸς Σαουλ καὶ ἦν ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ ὡσεὶ ἐχθὲς καὶ τρίτην ἡμέραν

text_en: And the war began again, and David went out, and fought against the Philistines , and defeated them with a great slaughter, and they fled from his face.
text_la: Motum est autem rursum bellum : et egressus David, pugnavit adversum Philisthiim : percussitque eos plaga magna, et fugerunt a facie ejus.
text_pt: E tornou a haver guerra; e saiu Davi, e pelejou contra os filisteus, e feriu-os com grande matança, e fugiram diante dele.
text_el: καὶ προσέθετο ὁ πόλεμος γενέσθαι πρὸς Σαουλ καὶ κατίσχυσεν Δαυιδ καὶ ἐπολέμησεν τοὺς ἀλλοφύλους καὶ ἐπάταξεν ἐν αὐτοῖς πληγὴν μεγάλην σφόδρα καὶ ἔφυγον ἐκ προσώπου αὐτοῦ

text_en: And the evil spirit from the Lord came upon Saul ; and he sat in his house, and held a spear in his hand: and David played with his hand.
text_la: Et factus est spiritus Domini malus in Saul : sedebat autem in domo sua, et tenebat lanceam : porro David psallebat manu sua.
text_pt: Porém o espírito mau da parte do Senhor se tornou sobre Saul, estando ele assentado em sua casa, e tendo na mão a sua lança; e tocava Davi com a mão, a harpa.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο πνεῦμα θεοῦ πονηρὸν ἐπὶ Σαουλ καὶ αὐτὸς ἐν οἴκῳ καθεύδων καὶ δόρυ ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ Δαυιδ ἔψαλλεν ἐν ταῖς χερσὶν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Saul endeavoured to nail David to the wall with his spear. And David slipt away out of the presence of Saul : and the spear missed him, and was fastened in the wall, and David fled, and escaped that night.
text_la: Nisusque est Saul configere David lancea in pariete, et declinavit David a facie Saul : lancea autem casso vulnere perlata est in parietem, et David fugit, et salvatus est nocte illa.
text_pt: E procurou Saul encravar a Davi na parede, porém ele se desviou de diante de Saul, o qual feriu com a lança a parede; então fugiu Davi, e escapou naquela mesma noite.
text_el: καὶ ἐζήτει Σαουλ πατάξαι τὸ δόρυ εἰς Δαυιδ καὶ ἀπέστη Δαυιδ ἐκ προσώπου Σαουλ καὶ ἐπάταξεν τὸ δόρυ εἰς τὸν τοῖχον καὶ Δαυιδ ἀνεχώρησεν καὶ διεσώθη

text_en: Saul therefore sent his guards to David's house to watch him, that he might be killed in the morning. And when Michol, David's wife, had told him this, saying: Unless you save yourself this night, tomorrow you will die:
text_la: Misit ergo Saul satellites suos in domum David, ut custodirent eum, et interficeretur mane. Quod cum annuntiasset David Michol uxor sua, dicens : Nisi salvaveris te nocte hac, cras morieris:
text_pt: Porém Saul mandou mensageiros à casa de Davi, que o guardassem, e o matassem pela manhã; do que Mical, sua mulher, avisou a Davi, dizendo: Se não salvares a tua vida esta noite, amanhã te matarão.
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθη ἐν τῇ νυκτὶ ἐκείνῃ καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Σαουλ ἀγγέλους εἰς οἶκον Δαυιδ φυλάξαι αὐτὸν τοῦ θανατῶσαι αὐτὸν πρωί καὶ ἀπήγγειλεν τῷ Δαυιδ Μελχολ ἡ γυνὴ αὐτοῦ λέγουσα ἐὰν μὴ σὺ σώσῃς τὴν ψυχὴν σαυτοῦ τὴν νύκτα ταύτην αὔριον θανατωθήσῃ

text_en: She let him down through a window. And he went and fled away, and escaped.
text_la: deposuit eum per fenestram. Porro ille abiit et aufugit, atque salvatus est.
text_pt: Então Mical desceu a Davi por uma janela; e ele se foi, e fugiu, e escapou.
text_el: καὶ κατάγει ἡ Μελχολ τὸν Δαυιδ διὰ τῆς θυρίδος καὶ ἀπῆλθεν καὶ ἔφυγεν καὶ σῴζεται

text_en: And Michol took an image, and laid it on the bed, and put a goat's skin, with the hair at the head of it, and covered it with clothes.
text_la: Tulit autem Michol statuam, et posuit eam super lectum, et pellem pilosam caprarum posuit ad caput ejus, et operuit eam vestimentis.
text_pt: E Mical tomou uma estátua e a deitou na cama, e pôs-lhe à cabeceira uma pele de cabra, e a cobriu com uma coberta.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν ἡ Μελχολ τὰ κενοτάφια καὶ ἔθετο ἐπὶ τὴν κλίνην καὶ ἧπαρ τῶν αἰγῶν ἔθετο πρὸς κεφαλῆς αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐκάλυψεν αὐτὰ ἱματίῳ

text_en: And Saul sent officers to seize David ; and it was answered that he was sick.
text_la: Misit autem Saul apparitores, qui raperent David : et responsum est quod ægrotaret.
text_pt: E, mandando Saul mensageiros que trouxessem a Davi, ela disse: Está doente.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Σαουλ ἀγγέλους λαβεῖν τὸν Δαυιδ καὶ λέγουσιν ἐνοχλεῖσθαι αὐτόν

text_en: And again Saul sent to see David , saying: Bring him to me in the bed, that he may be slain.
text_la: Rursumque misit Saul nuntios ut viderent David, dicens : Afferte eum ad me in lecto, ut occidatur.
text_pt: Então Saul tornou a mandar mensageiros que fossem a Davi, dizendo: Trazei-mo na cama, para que o mate.
text_el: καὶ ἀποστέλλει ἐπὶ τὸν Δαυιδ λέγων ἀγάγετε αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τῆς κλίνης πρός με τοῦ θανατῶσαι αὐτόν

text_en: And when the messengers had come in, they found an image upon the bed, and a goat skin at his head.
text_la: Cumque venissent nuntii, inventum est simulacrum super lectum, et pellis caprarum ad caput ejus.
text_pt: Vindo, pois, os mensageiros, eis que a estátua estava na cama, e a pele de cabra à sua cabeceira.
text_el: καὶ ἔρχονται οἱ ἄγγελοι καὶ ἰδοὺ τὰ κενοτάφια ἐπὶ τῆς κλίνης καὶ ἧπαρ τῶν αἰγῶν πρὸς κεφαλῆς αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Saul said to Michol: Why have you deceived me so, and let my enemy go and flee away? And Michol answered Saul : Because he said to me: Let me go, or else I will kill you.
text_la: Dixitque Saul ad Michol : Quare sic illusisti mihi, et dimisisti inimicum meum ut fugeret? Et respondit Michol ad Saul : Quia ipse locutus est mihi : Dimitte me, alioquin interficiam te.
text_pt: Então disse Saul a Mical: Por que assim me enganaste, e deixaste ir e escapar o meu inimigo? E disse Mical a Saul: Porque ele me disse: Deixa-me ir, por que hei de eu matar-te?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Σαουλ τῇ Μελχολ ἵνα τί οὕτως παρελογίσω με καὶ ἐξαπέστειλας τὸν ἐχθρόν μου καὶ διεσώθη καὶ εἶπεν Μελχολ τῷ Σαουλ αὐτὸς εἶπεν ἐξαπόστειλόν με εἰ δὲ μή θανατώσω σε

text_en: But David fled and escaped, and came to Samuel in Ramatha, and told him all that Saul had done to him: and he and Samuel went and dwelt in Najoth.
text_la: David autem fugiens salvatus est, et venit ad Samuel in Ramatha, et nuntiavit ei omnia quæ fecerat sibi Saul : et abierunt ipse et Samuel, et morati sunt in Najoth.
text_pt: Assim Davi fugiu e escapou, e foi a Samuel, em Ramá, e lhe participou tudo quanto Saul lhe fizera; e foram, ele e Samuel, e ficaram em Naiote.
text_el: καὶ Δαυιδ ἔφυγεν καὶ διεσώθη καὶ παραγίνεται πρὸς Σαμουηλ εἰς Αρμαθαιμ καὶ ἀπαγγέλλει αὐτῷ πάντα ὅσα ἐποίησεν αὐτῷ Σαουλ καὶ ἐπορεύθη Δαυιδ καὶ Σαμουηλ καὶ ἐκάθισαν ἐν Ναυαθ ἐν Ραμα

text_en: And it was told Saul by some, saying: Behold David is in Najoth, in Ramatha.
text_la: Nuntiatum est autem Sauli a dicentibus: Ecce David in Najoth in Ramatha.
text_pt: E o anunciaram a Saul, dizendo: Eis que Davi está em Naiote, em Ramá.
text_el: καὶ ἀπηγγέλη τῷ Σαουλ λέγοντες ἰδοὺ Δαυιδ ἐν Ναυαθ ἐν Ραμα
